//@version=6
strategy("Operator controls", overlay = true, pyramiding = 0, default_qty_type = strategy.fixed, default_qty_value = 1, initial_capital = 1000000000, process_orders_on_close = false)
enum Mode
    fast
    slow
Mode a = Mode.fast
Mode b = Mode.slow
bool r = a == b
plot(close)
if bar_index > 6 and bar_index % 7 == 3
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, qty = 1)
if bar_index > 6 and bar_index % 7 == 5
    strategy.close("L")
derivation: An existing accepted control: the operand domains admit this operator; no value is inferred from the fixed orders.
